VAR Metric = SELECTEDVALUE('Weekly DTC (detail) demand'[Metrics])

VAR DemandMetrics = "Demand /  Gross Retail Sales $"

VAR DemandTY = 
VAR LastDateAvailable = LASTDATE('Date Table'[Date])
VAR LastFiscalYearMonthAvailable = MAX('Date Table'[Week End Date])
VAR LastFiscalYear = MAX('Date Table'[Year])
RETURN 
    CALCULATE (
       [Demand Gross Retail Sales $],
        ALLEXCEPT('Date Table', 'Date Table'[Select a Calendar], 'Date Table'[Week End Date]),
        'Date Table'[Date] <= LastDateAvailable,
        'Date Table'[Week End Date] = LastFiscalYearMonthAvailable,
        'Date Table'[Year] = LastFiscalYear
    )

VAR Budget = 
VAR LastDateAvailable = LASTDATE('Date Table'[Date])
VAR LastFiscalYearMonthAvailable = MAX('Date Table'[Week End Date])
VAR LastFiscalYear = MAX('Date Table'[Year])
RETURN 
    CALCULATE(
        [Budget demand],
        ALLEXCEPT('Date Table', 'Date Table'[Select a Calendar], 'Date Table'[Week End Date]),
        KEEPFILTERS(
            'Date Table'[Date] <= LastDateAvailable &&
            'Date Table'[Week End Date] = LastFiscalYearMonthAvailable &&
            'Date Table'[Year] = LastFiscalYear
        )
    )

VAR DemandLY = 
VAR LastDateAvailable = LASTDATE('Date Table'[Date])
VAR LastFiscalYearMonthAvailable = MAX('Date Table'[Week End Date])
VAR LastFiscalYear = MAX('Date Table'[Year]) - 1
RETURN 
    CALCULATE (
       [Demand Gross Retail Sales $],
        ALLEXCEPT('Date Table', 'Date Table'[Select a Calendar], 'Date Table'[Week End Date]),
        'Date Table'[Date] <= LastDateAvailable,
        'Date Table'[Week End Date] = LastFiscalYearMonthAvailable,
        'Date Table'[Year] = LastFiscalYear
    )

VAR DemandLLY = 
VAR LastDateAvailable = LASTDATE('Date Table'[Date])
VAR LastFiscalYearMonthAvailable = MAX('Date Table'[Week End Date])
VAR LastFiscalYear = MAX('Date Table'[Year]) - 2
RETURN 
    CALCULATE (
       [Demand Gross Retail Sales $],
        ALLEXCEPT('Date Table', 'Date Table'[Select a Calendar], 'Date Table'[Week End Date]),
        'Date Table'[Date] <= LastDateAvailable,
        'Date Table'[Week End Date] = LastFiscalYearMonthAvailable,
        'Date Table'[Year] = LastFiscalYear
    )

VAR Forecast = 
VAR LastDateAvailable = LASTDATE('Date Table'[Date])
VAR LastFiscalYearMonthAvailable = MAX('Date Table'[Week End Date])
VAR LastFiscalYear = MAX('Date Table'[Year])
RETURN 
    CALCULATE(
        [Forecast Demand],
        ALLEXCEPT('Date Table', 'Date Table'[Select a Calendar], 'Date Table'[Week End Date]),
        KEEPFILTERS(
            'Date Table'[Date] <= LastDateAvailable &&
            'Date Table'[Week End Date] = LastFiscalYearMonthAvailable &&
            'Date Table'[Year] = LastFiscalYear
        )
    )

    DemandLY = 0,
    BLANK(),
    DIVIDE((DemandTY - DemandLY), DemandLY)
)

VAR PercvsLLY = IF(
    DemandLLY = 0,
    BLANK(),
    DIVIDE((DemandTY - DemandLLY), DemandLLY)
)

    "TY", DemandTY,

    "% vs. LLY", PercvsLLY,
    "$ vs. LLY", DemandTY - DemandLLY,
    BLANK()
)

    SWITCH(

    )
